network.snippet: e Offloading Risks **Risk 1: Students Google "how to measure spread."** If students have internet access, they will find "standard deviation" within 30 seconds, bypassing the entire generation phase. **Mitigation:** This is

sensitive.snippet: nproductive. If frustration persists at 15 minutes, begin Phase 2 early — you have enough student approaches to work with. **Condition 4: The consolidation must be thorough.** If you run out of time, cut the practice questions (Step 4)
